verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Ramp's bill pay flow routes vendor invoices for payment (ramp-docs-2), implying ACH/wire payment capability, but there is no explicit documentation of domestic ACH or wire payment mechanics, fees, timing, or limits, nor independent confirmation of wire payments specifically. Missing for 10: explicit ACH/wire payment documentation, wire-specific details, and independent/hands-on confirmation of successful vendor ACH/wire payments.
